Khamenei has not been seen in public since being injured in US-Israeli airstrikes six months ago that launched the Iran war, killing his father and previous supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. His call for unity echoes a statement he made on Friday to Iranians, when he said he had banned actions that harm social cohesion and urged authorities to avoid "discouraging statements" that weaken national and public morale. Khamenei specifically asked Gulf Arab rulers whether "rogues without identity" would have dared to covet their lands and possessions if the peoples and governments of the Gulf had been "united under the flag of Islam". Since the 1979 Islamic Revolution, Gulf Arab monarchies have viewed Iran's revolutionary ideology, including its anti-monarchic rhetoric and regional influence, as a threat to their political systems.  During the present conflict, Tehran has struck US military facilities as well as other infrastructure in Gulf states, underscoring the tensions between Tehran and its Gulf neighbours. "My emphatic and repeated recommendation to the rulers of Islamic countries, especially the countries of West Asia and the Gulf, is to identify your real enemy, understand his plan and confront it," Khamenei said.

item.title: India's HDFC Bank weighing deputy MD Bharucha, outsider for CEO, sources say
item.description: HDFC Bank is likely to name Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha as one of two options for its next CEO after incumbent Sashidhar Jagdishan retires at the end of his second term in October, two people familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Gopika Gopakumar
item.content:encoded: HDFC Bank (HDBK.NS) is likely to name Deputy Managing Director Kaizad Bharucha as one of two options for its next CEO after incumbent Sashidhar Jagdishan retires at the end of his second term in October, two people familiar with the matter said. India's largest private lender is also searching for an external candidate in keeping with a central bank rule requiring banks submit multiple names for the CEO position, the people said, declining to be identified as the information was private. The Reserve Bank of India approves top banking appointments. Neither HDFC Bank nor Bharucha responded to emails seeking comment outside of regular business hours. The CEO search comes after about six months of upheaval at HDFC Bank where leadership issues have weighed on its shares. The bank announced Jagdishan's [USN:L1N44Q03M TEXT:"retirement"] on Saturday. He had been widely tipped to continue as CEO before Atanu Chakraborty resigned as chairman in March saying practices at the bank were at odds with his "personal values and ethics". An external legal review found [USN:L4N42Y132 TEXT:"no evidence"] to substantiate Chakraborty's governance concerns. Last month, the board [USN:L4N43T0QY TEXT:"penalised"] Jagdishan and three others in a separate matter related to the pricing of large deposits. The bank said on Saturday without elaborating that its CEO since October 2020 had decided not to seek reappointment and that it would fast-track the appointment of a successor. Among the leading internal candidates is Bharucha, a long-serving executive overseeing the retail and wholesale businesses, the people said. Bharucha is not due to retire until 2029, when he will have been a full-time director for 15 years, making him eligible to be CEO under RBI rules. The maximum tenure of a so-called whole-time director is 15 years, though exemptions can be sought. The price of HDFC Bank shares, which were about 40% foreign-owned as at June-end, has fallen 27% this year, with the decline accelerating after Chakraborty's departure. Investors have also [USN:L4N40B0WF TEXT:"voiced concern"] over the lack of gains from a 2023 merger overseen by Jagdishan with then-parent HDFC Ltd.

item.title: Manhunt underway after woman killed, several injured at Swiss rave shooting
item.description: A 22-year-old woman has been killed and five people injured, one seriously, in a shooting overnight at a rave in the Swiss town of Aarau which local police said could have been an act of terrorism.
item.dc:creator: Romina Amato, John Revill
item.content:encoded: A 22-year-old woman has been killed and five people injured, one seriously, in a shooting overnight at a rave in the Swiss town of Aarau which local police said could have been an act of terrorism. Local police said all victims are residents of Switzerland and in their 20s. Italy's foreign ministry said Swiss authorities had informed them that an Italian woman had died, and Italy offered its support with the investigation. Swiss President Guy Parmelin offered condolences to the family of the victim. "In these difficult hours, my full sympathy goes to all people affected by this tragic event," he said on social media. A manhunt is underway and large areas of the town have been cordoned off, police said, appealing to the public for any images of the incident. But police admitted that they were at the early stages of the investigation, and that they did not yet know how many attackers there were, nor their motives. "The end is not in sight," Aargau's Police Commander Michael Leupold told reporters. "Where an active shooter is firing into a crowd of thousands of people at an event, it's perfectly clear that we consider terrorism as a motive," he said, adding that investigators were also considering a mass shooting or an unknown criminal motive for the attack. "We are treating all three possibilities as equally likely." HIDING BEHIND THE DJ BOOTH A 34-year-old witness who asked for anonymity told Reuters he heard shots shortly after the music stopped at 2:30 a.m. (0030 GMT) on Sunday, which he initially mistook for fireworks. Some took cover behind a DJ booth and one woman hid behind a refrigerator, but was hit in the back by a bullet and bled to death despite efforts to revive her, he said. "It's just incredibly tragic. She was young," he told Reuters. "That something like this could happen in Aarau, at a local event, is simply unimaginable. I still can't really process it." Police said a 22-year-old woman had died from her injuries at the scene and that one other person was seriously injured, but not in a life-threatening situation. CONVOYS AND ARMOURED VEHICLES Police have increased their presence beyond the town — about 50 km west of Zurich and 30 km south of the German border — as a precaution, although police spokesperson Bernhard Graser said there were indications the shooter or shooters were no longer in the immediate area. "But (we) still have a lot of police here in the area, in the town of Aarau, in the whole state (canton) to make sure that we could get them if they're still around," he said. "Currently the extensive manhunt is running tirelessly throughout Switzerland." Reuters footage showed armed officers patrolling the area, police convoys moving through the streets, and armoured vehicles parked near the crime scene. Cartridges found at the crime scene indicated two calibres of bullets, possibly from a pistol and a second, larger weapon, potentially an assault rifle or machine gun, police said. The organisers' website advertised the event as a techno party at a covered horse racetrack, with 3,500 people expected to attend. Organisers said they were shocked and heartbroken by the incident. "A rave should always be a place of joy and love, never a place where people are killed, injured, or left in fear," they said. Switzerland has one of the highest rates of gun ownership in Europe, although violent shootings are rare and it approved tighter gun control rules in 2019.

item.title: テニス＝ジョコビッチ、歴代単独最多四大大会25勝目に意欲
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: ［ニューヨーク　２９日　ロイター］ - 男子テニスの元世界ランキング１位、ノバク・ジョコビッチ（３９、セルビア）は、３０日に開幕する全米オープン（ＯＰ）で歴代単独最多となる四大大会２５回目の優勝を目指す。 　ジョコビッチは２０２３年の全米ＯＰで優勝し、四大大会２４勝目を達成。マーガレット・コートさん（オーストラリア）が持つ男女歴代最多記録に並んだ。しかしその後、四大大会では決勝には２回、準決勝には６回進出したものの、単独最多となる２５勝目には届いていない。 　それでもジョコビッチは挑戦を諦めておらず、今月発表されたドキュメンタリーで「何年も前から多くの人が私を引退扱いしているのは知っている」としながらも、「まだ最高レベルで戦っているのに、なぜ私に引退してほしいのか。私は今でも世界のトップ５、トップ１０以内。まだ勝てるということを自分自身に証明しているのだから、引退の話などするわけがない」と述べている。 　ジョコビッチは去年、四大大会の全てで準決勝敗退。今年の全豪ＯＰでは決勝に進出し、ウィンブルドン選手権では４強入りを果たした。同選手は７月のウィンブルドンで敗退後、「９９％の選手はこれを四大大会でのとてもいい結果とみなすだろう。私としてもいい結果だが、これでは不十分。幸か不幸か、最高の結果と功績を残すことに慣れてしまったからだ」と話した。 　第４シードのジョコビッチは３０日、全米ＯＰのシングルス１回戦で、世界ランク４８位のマリアノ・ナボネ（アルゼンチン）と対戦する。

item.title: 米国とのエネルギー合意は25年間有効＝ベネズエラ暫定大統領
item.description: [カラカス ２９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[カラカス ２９日 ロイター] - ベネズエラのロドリゲス暫定大統領は２９日、米国とのエネルギー協定は２５年間有効で、原油生産量を日量１５０万バレルに増やすことが目標とした上で、国内天然資源に対する主権は維持すると表明した。

ロドリゲス氏は深夜の演説で、「歴史的な」合意と称賛、経済再生と政府歳入の増加の一助となり、ベネズエラの未来形成に役立つと述べた。

トランプ米大統領は２８日、世界最大とされるベネズエラの原油埋蔵量の２０％について、米国が支配権を確保したと表明した。

item.title: サッカー＝ボルシアＭＧが開幕戦で完敗、橋岡は先発も負傷交代
item.description: ［２９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: ［２９日　ロイター］　 - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは２９日、各地で開幕節の試合を行い、板倉滉と橋岡大樹が先発したボルシアＭＧは、橋岡が負傷交代というアクシデントも発生し、ライプチヒに０─３で完敗した。 　ボルシアＭＧは前半２６分に失点すると、追い付くことのできないまま後半にも２点を奪われた。橋岡は後半に相手選手との衝突により首を負傷。手当てを受け、同３０分に交代した。地元メディアは橋岡が病院に搬送され、頚椎損傷の可能性を指摘している。 　ボルシアＭＧの町野修斗はベンチ入りするも出番はなかった。同僚の宇野禅斗はベンチ外。 　小杉啓太がフル出場したアイントラハト・フランクフルトはウニオン・ベルリンと３─３の引き分け。ユネス・エブヌタリブのハットトリックで後半２２分まで２点をリードしていたが、守り切ることができなかった。チームメートの堂安律はベンチ外だった。 　佐野海舟がフル出場したマインツはパーダーボルンとスコアレスドローに終わった。マインツの川崎颯太はベンチ入りしたが、出番はなかった。ホッフェンハイムはケルンに２─３で競り負けた。ホッフェンハイムの町田浩樹はベンチ入りしなかった。 　今季初めてトップリーグ参戦となった昇格組エルフェアスベルクはレーバークーゼンに３─２で勝利。本拠地の人口わずか１万３０００人のクラブがうれしい白星スタートを切った。 　その他、ドルトムントはハンブルガーＳＶに２─０で快勝した。

item.title: L'Islande dit "non" à une reprise des négociations d'adhésion à l'UE
item.description: Les Islandais ont rejeté dimanche la proposition d'une reprise des négociations d'adhésion à l'Union européenne (UE) à l'issue du référendum organisé samedi, infligeant un camouflet au gouvernement et se rangeant du côté de ceux qui y voyaient un risque quant à la souveraineté des eaux de pêche du pays.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les Islandais ont rejeté dimanche la proposition d'une reprise des négociations d'adhésion à l'Union européenne (UE) à l'issue du [USN:L6N44Q009 TEXT:"référendum"] organisé samedi, infligeant un camouflet au gouvernement et se rangeant du côté de ceux qui y voyaient un risque quant à la souveraineté des eaux de pêche du pays. Après le dépouillement de la totalité des bulletins de votes, les électeurs se sont prononcés à 52,8% contre la proposition du gouvernement d'entamer des négociations avec Bruxelles, tandis que le "oui" a recueilli 47,2% des voix, ont rapporté la chaîne de télévision publique RUV et d'autres médias islandais. Le gouvernement avait présenté son projet d'adhésion comme un moment décisif, "maintenant ou jamais", et la Première ministre Kristrun Frostadottir avait déclaré aux électeurs en août qu'un "non" mettrait fin à toutes les spéculations autour de l'UE. "C'est un net revers pour Bruxelles", a reconnu auprès de Reuters dimanche un diplomate de l'UE, ajoutant que les questions liées à la pêche et à l'indépendance avaient pesé. Au cours d'une conférence de presse, la Première ministre islandaise a déclaré que le pays continuerait de renforcer ses liens avec l'Espace économique européen (EEE), qui regroupe les 27 pays de l'Union ainsi que trois pays de l'Association européenne de libre-échange (AELE), l'Islande, le Liechtenstein et la Norvège. L'Union européenne respecte pleinement le choix démocratique du peuple islandais et l'Islande demeure l'un des partenaires les plus proches et les plus de confiance de l'UE, a dit le président du conseil européen Antonio Costa à la Première ministre islandaise, selon des propos rapporté par un porte-parole du président. Les deux dirigeants ont exprimé leur désir de continuer à renforcer leurs relations mutuelles, a-t-il ajouté. Avant le référendum, à Bruxelles, certains responsables avaient présenté l'Islande, cet Etat insulaire de 400.000 habitants, comme un dossier à faible risque, susceptible même d'atténuer le scepticisme à l'égard de l'élargissement de l'UE et de renforcer stratégiquement le bloc communautaire alors que la question de la sécurité dans l'Arctique prend de plus en plus d'importance. Le président américain Donald Trump a déclaré à plusieurs reprises qu'il souhaitait conclure un accord pour acquérir le Groenland, île située entre l'océan Atlantique et l'océan Arctique. Plus largement, les bouleversements géopolitiques, notamment la guerre au Moyen-Orient, ont alimenté l'inflation et accru la vulnérabilité des petites économies. Le principal taux directeur de la banque centrale islandaise est de 8%, contre 2,25% pour celui de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE). LA SÉCURITÉ RELÉGUÉE AU SECOND PLAN En Islande, les débats ont porté davantage sur les taux d'intérêt, les droits de pêche et le coût de la vie que sur la sécurité. Les partisans du "oui" affirmaient que l'adhésion à l'UE pourrait faire baisser le niveau des taux d'intérêt en Islande. "Cela ne résoudrait pas les problèmes structurels de l'Islande, mais cela pourrait devenir un catalyseur pour une économie plus saine", avait déclaré Vilhjalmur Hilmarsson, chef économiste chez Viska, un syndicat professionnel islandais de premier plan. Les partisans du "non", de leur côté, soutenaient que l'adhésion à l'UE menacerait la souveraineté de l'île et ses zones de pêche. Dans la réglementation européenne, les quotas de pêche sont établis, entre autres, en fonction des pratiques de pêche historiques. Certains responsables islandais ont déclaré que l'Islande conserverait donc le contrôle de ses eaux, aucun pays de l'UE n'y ayant pratiqué la pêche depuis des décennies. La cheffe de l'opposition, Gudrun Hafsteinsdottir, qui a mené la campagne du "non", avait déclaré que les arguments économiques en faveur du "oui" étaient exagérés. "Ce ne sont pas des problèmes que Bruxelles va résoudre pour nous. Ce sont des problèmes que les responsables politiques islandais doivent résoudre", avait-elle affirmé. L'Islande a déposé sa candidature à l'UE en 2009, après l'effondrement de son système bancaire l'année précédente. Quatre années de négociations plus tard, un gouvernement eurosceptique a suspendu le processus en 2013. VOIR AUSSI: LE POINT sur le référendum en Islande sur les négociations d'adhésion à l'UE. ([USN:L8N44P0SC TEXT:"Full Story"])

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝千賀所属のメッツ、オールスター外野手のソトが戦列復帰
item.description: ［２９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: ［２９日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）、千賀滉大投手が所属するメッツのフアン・ソト外野手（２７）が２９日、負傷者リスト（ＩＬ）から復帰。アストロズ戦に「２番・指名打者」で出場した。 　　ソトは４打数１安打１打点、１得点。６─２の勝利に貢献した。同選手は７月２５日、左ふくらはぎのけがで１０日間のＩＬに登録。４月は右ふくらはぎのけがで１５試合を欠場していた。 　ソトはメッツと１５年の長期契約を結んでおり、２年目の今季は８５試合で打率２割８分３厘、２１本塁打、５３打点の成績。 メジャー９年間の通算成績は打率２割８分２厘、２６５本塁打、７５０打点。オールスターには今年を含めて５回選出されている。

item.title: Venezuela's interim president says US energy deal will last 25 years
item.description: The deal would target an increase in crude output to 1.5 million barrels per day.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Venezuelan interim President Delcy Rodriguez said on Saturday that an energy agreement with the [USN:FWN44P1ZC TEXT:"U.S."] would remain in force for 25 years, target an increase in crude output to 1.5 million barrels per day (bpd) and preserve the country's sovereignty over its natural resources. Rodriguez hailed the accord in a late-night address as a "historic" deal that would help revive the economy and boost government revenue, saying it would help shape the country's future. “This 25-year bilateral project envisages the development of 17 strategic oilfields with a production target of more than 1.5 million barrels per day," Rodriguez said on state broadcaster VTV. "That figure relates solely to the bilateral agreement between Venezuela and the United States." Rodriguez added that the agreement's target of 1.5 million bpd was only an initial goal and that the broader plan also included the development of eight greenfield oil blocks as part of a wider expansion of the country's energy sector. President Donald Trump on Friday announced plans for the U.S. to take partial control of Venezuela's vast oil reserves, betting that American companies can help revive the South American nation's battered energy industry while providing a new source of crude to help lower U.S. fuel prices. Trump provided few details on the agreement, saying only that the U.S. had secured majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of Venezuela's proven oil reserves through a partnership with private business. Venezuela has the world's largest proven oil reserves, but it produces only about 1.25 million bpd - far below its potential - after years of underinvestment, mismanagement and sanctions. Rodriguez said the agreement could generate about $209 billion in revenue for the Venezuelan state, based on a benchmark oil price of $65 per barrel, though she acknowledged crude prices could fluctuate. She said roughly $19 from each barrel produced and sold under the arrangement would flow directly to Venezuela, providing a significant boost to government revenue. She said that the country retained “ownership of and sovereignty” over its natural resources, “while leveraging capital, technology and operational expertise to support the recovery of a strategic industry that has been severely affected by sanctions." Earlier on Saturday, dozens of pro-government groups gathered in downtown Caracas to protest against the U.S. presence in Venezuela. Rodriguez welcomed the agreement following Trump's announcement, saying it would bolster economic growth and increase government revenue. Venezuelan officials are preparing to sign agreements next week granting new oil exploration and production rights to several companies, including U.S. firms. Two sources close to the negotiations said on Friday that [USN:L6N44P13H TEXT:"Chevron CVX.N was among the companies"] expected to finalize talks to transition its Venezuelan joint ventures into the country's new energy framework.

item.title: ゴルフ＝ＦＭ選手権で山下12位に後退、殷若寧が単独首位に浮上
item.description: ［２９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: ［２９日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフのＦＭ選手権は２９日、マサチューセッツ州ノートンのＴＰＣボストン（パー７２）で第３ラウンドを行い、首位でスタートした山下美夢有は１２位に順位を下げた。 　２週連続優勝を目指す山下は２バーディー、５ボギーの３オーバー７５で回り、通算６アンダーの２１０となった。 最終ホールでチップインバーディーを奪った殷若寧（中国）が通算１２アンダーの単独首位に浮上。この日は４アンダー６８で回った。２３歳の同選手はキャリア６勝目を狙っている。キム・セヨンとキム・ヒョージュ（ともに韓国）が１打差の２位につけた。 　西郷真央は通算５アンダーの１６位に浮上した。岩井明愛は通算４アンダーの２３位。勝みなみと畑岡奈紗は通算３アンダーの２８位となった。

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝ドジャースはサヨナラ負け、カブス鈴木が23号本塁打
item.description: ［２９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: ［２９日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は２９日、各地で試合を行い、ドジャースの大谷翔平選手はタイガース戦に「１番・指名打者」で出場。４打数１安打、１三振だった。ドジャースは１─２のサヨナラ負けを喫した。 　ドジャースは直近５試合で４敗目。シーズン後半戦、１点差ゲームでは１０敗目となった。先発ブレーク・スネル投手が５回３安打１失点、１０奪三振と好投したが、報われなかった。 　カブスの鈴木誠也外野手はレッズ戦に「２番・指名打者」で出場。２３号２ランを含む、５打数３安打２打点、３得点の活躍だった。カブスは１７─５で大勝した。 　ホワイトソックスの村上宗隆内野手はツインズ戦に「２番・一塁」で出場し、２打数無安打、２四球、１三振。ホワイトソックスは３─２で競り勝ち、４連勝とした。 ブルージェイズの岡本和真内野手はマリナーズ戦に「５番・三塁」で出場。２打数ノーヒット、２四球、１三振だった。ブルージェイズは４─３で逆転勝ち。 　メッツの千賀滉大投手はアストロズ戦、４点リードの九回に３番手として登板。１回１安打無失点に抑えた。メッツは６─２で勝った。パドレスの松井裕樹投手はレイズ戦に５番手として登板。１回無安打無失点、１四球、１奪三振だった。パドレスは６─７で負けた。

item.title: サッカー＝中村の劇的ゴールはＶＡＲで無効に、ルアーブル引き分け
item.description: ［２９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: ［２９日　ロイター］ - サッカーのフランス１部は２９日、各地で試合を行い、リヨンと対戦したルアーブルは終了間際に中村草太がゴールを挙げたが、ビデオ・アシスタント・レフェリー（ＶＡＲ）の介入で無効となり、１─１の引き分けに終わった。　　ルアーブルは１─１で迎えた後半アディショナルタイム、同３１分から出場した中村がこぼれ球を押し込み、劇的勝利を収めたかと思われた。しかし、ＶＡＲの検証結果で、それより前のシーンで味方にハンドがあったと確認され、取り消しとなった。 　ルアーブルでは瀬古歩夢がフル出場。水多海斗は先発し、後半２０分までプレーした。 　その他、ランスはストラスブールに１─２で敗れ、アンジェはオセールに３─１で快勝。ブレストとトゥールーズは２─２で引き分け、トロワはロリアンを２─１で破った。

item.title: Norway's King Haakon honours 'dear father' Harald in first speech as sovereign
item.description: "I am going to miss him. I am going to miss his laughter. I am going to miss his good-natured way to meet people and situations," said King Haakon.

Norway's King Haakon honours 'dear father' Harald in first speech as sovereign

"I am going to miss him. I am going to miss his laughter. I am going to miss his good-natured way to meet people and situations," said King Haakon.

Norway's new king, King Haakon, sits on the day he will give his first speech as monarch at the palace, following the death of Norway's King Harald, in Oslo, Norway, Aug 29, 2026. (Photo: Heiko Junge/NTB/via Reuters)

FAST

OSLO: King Haakon VIII of Norway paid homage to his late father as "such a good dad" in his first address to the nation since becoming sovereign, his voice briefly filling with emotion when evoking his widowed mother Queen Sonja. King Harald , who emerged from the shadow of his own well-loved, extrovert father to become a reformer during more than three decades on the throne, died on Friday at the age of 89. His son Haakon, dressed in a black suit, white shirt and black tie, praised Harald as a warm family man in a recorded televised speech at the palace. "My dear father, thank you for being such a good dad for Martha and I," he said, referring to his sister, Princess Martha Louise.

"I am going to miss him. I am going to miss his laughter. I am going to miss his good-natured way to meet people and situations," he continued, sitting behind a desk, with a portrait of a smiling Harald to his left. He noted that Saturday should have been the celebration of the 58th wedding anniversary of Harald and Queen Sonja, who survives him. "Congratulations on your wedding anniversary, dear Mummy," Haakon said, his voice appearing briefly overtaken by emotion.

Mourners gather in the pouring rain to watch as King Harald V's remains arrive to the Royal Palace in Oslo, Norway, on Aug 28, 2026. (Photo: Heiko Junge/NTB via AP)

ONE PEOPLE Haakon stressed he would do things his own way, like his father did before him, and reiterated the foundations of Norway as a constitutional monarchy, embodied by the oath he will take in parliament on Tuesday to protect the country's constitution and laws. "We believe in our system of self-governance – and in democracy. We believe in a society built on the rule of law – where every individual has equal worth," he said. Haakon automatically became king upon his father's death under Norway's constitutional monarchy. There will be no coronation as they were abolished by parliament in 1908. "We believe in a Norway where there is room for everyone. We shall feel the strength of our community - and know deep within ourselves that we are one people," he said. At the end of his speech, outside the palace, mourners who had been watching on their mobile phones broke into spontaneous applause. Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Stoere, speaking to Reuters minutes before the broadcast of the speech, said Haakon shared many qualities with his father. "This King has something from his father, which is the ability to create an atmosphere of togetherness," he said in an interview outside the palace.

File photo. Norway's King Harald, in the presence of Crown Prince Haakon, delivers a speech during the opening of the Storting, Norway's parliament, in Oslo, Norway on Oct 11, 2021. (Photo: Reuters/Torstein Boe)

TOLERANCE AND INCLUSIVENESS Since Harald's passing, people have streamed in their tens of thousands to say goodbye to the late king at the royal palace, where he lies in state, with many well-wishers remembering his sense of inclusiveness and tolerance. Flags were flying at half-mast throughout the country and portraits of the late king in gala uniform could be seen at bus stops, trams and metro stations to shops, offices and public buildings. The main avenue in central Oslo, Karl Johan, was tightly packed with people from all walks of life heading towards the palace, clutching flowers, handwritten cards, drawings and small national flags. Mourners praised the late king's spirit of inclusiveness. "He meant a lot to us immigrants ... We felt really very included. So, thanks to him, I feel so Norwegian," Veselina Vitanova, a 43-year-old teacher originally from Bulgaria, told Reuters outside the palace. Another referred to a speech Harald delivered in 2016 that went viral worldwide, in which he said: "Norwegians are girls who love girls, boys who love boys and girls and boys who love each other". "It embodies the way he felt about people and the way he wanted us Norwegians to feel about each other," said Mari Eidsvaag, 32, who wore a T-shirt emblazoned with that sentence, a rainbow and a drawing of King Harald. "I think it's a very important statement, especially these days," she told Reuters.

Source: Reuters/aj

item.title: サッカー＝ハル開幕2連勝、守田と坂元がプレミアリーグデビュー
item.description: ［リバプール ２９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: ［リバプール　２９日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグは２９日、各地で試合を行い、ハルがコベントリーとの昇格組対決に１─０で勝利。開幕２連勝を飾った。 　ハルは途中出場のリアム・ミラーが後半３７分に得点。これが決勝点となった。ハルの守田英正は先発し、前半のみプレー。コベントリーの坂元達裕は後半１４分から出場した。守田と坂元はともにこれがプレミアリーグデビューとなった。 　遠藤航が所属するリバプールはノッティンガム・フォレストと２─２のドロー。試合終盤に新加入ビクトル・ムニョスのゴールで追い付き、開幕から２試合連続の引き分けに終わった。遠藤はベンチ入りしたが、出番はなかった。 　高井幸大が所属するトットナムはニューカッスルに０─２で敗れ、開幕２連敗。高井はベンチを外れた。この他、ボーンマスとエバートンが１─１で引き分けた。

item.title: サッカー＝アトレチコ快勝、久保出場のソシエダード今季初勝利
item.description: ［２９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: ［２９日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部は２９日、各地で試合を行い、アトレチコ・マドリードは敵地でセビリアに３─１と快勝した。 　アトレチコは前半４分にアレックス・バエナのゴールで先制すると、同２６分にアデモラ・ルックマンが追加点を挙げ、その７分後にバエナがこの日自身２点目をマーク。後半に１点を返されたが、２点のリードを守り切った。 　久保建英が所属するレアル・ソシエダードはエスパニョールに２─１で競り勝ち、今季初白星。１─１と追い付かれて迎えた後半１６分にオーリ・オスカールソンが決勝ゴールを決めた。久保は後半３３分から出場した。 　その他、レバンテはベティスに５─２と大量点で初勝利をマークした。 　ここまで２勝１分けのアトレチコが勝ち点７で暫定首位に立っている。

item.title: ゴルフ＝ツアー選手権で松山25位に浮上、ホブランが単独首位
item.description: ［２９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: ［２９日　ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフの今季最終戦、ツアー選手権は２９日、アトランタのイーストレークＧＣ（パー７０）で第３ラウンドを行い、松山英樹は２５位に浮上した。 　　２７位で出た松山は６バーディー、３ボギーの３アンダー６７でラウンド。通算４アンダーの２０６とした。 　　５アンダー６５をマークしたビクトル・ホブラン（ノルウェー）が通算１５アンダーで単独トップ。首位タイでスタートしたライアン・ジェラード（米国）は１打差の２位に後退した。 　　世界ランキング１位のスコッティ・シェフラー（米国）、アダム・スコット（オーストラリア）ら４選手が首位と３打差の３位に並んだ。 　　今大会は年間ポイントランキング上位３０人が出場。優勝者が年間王者となり、賞金１０００万ドル（約１６億円）を獲得する。

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝ドジャース監督、大谷の状態は「100％ではないと思う」
item.description: ［２９日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded: ［２９日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）ドジャースのデーブ・ロバーツ監督は２９日、投手復活を目指す大谷翔平選手の状態について、万全ではないとの見方を示した。　　　　大谷は左膝と右上腕に痛みを抱えており、７月３日以降、試合で投げていない。今月３０日のタイガース戦で復帰し、短いイニングを投げる可能性があるとも報じられていたが、この試合にはタイラー・グラスノー投手が先発する予定。１０月のプレーオフ前に大谷をマウンドに戻すという、チームのプランの見通しも立っていない。 　　２８日に短いブルペン練習を行った大谷について、ロバーツ監督は２９日、報道陣に対し「彼の状態は１００％ではないと思う」とコメントした。 　状況をより複雑にしているのは、１番打者である大谷がチームの大きな得点源ということ。ピッチングを行うことにより、膝や腕の状態が悪化した場合、打者としての生産力にも影響しかねない。 　ロバーツ監督は「現在は先発投手陣がチームの強みであり、彼の攻撃面での価値は非常に大きい。それをいかなる形でも危険にさらすわけにはいかない」とし、「もし投げることが打撃に影響するのであれば、そこまでする価値はない」と話した。 　大谷はシーズン前半、１４試合に先発して８勝２敗、防御率１．７９。サイ・ヤング賞（最優秀投手賞）の候補に挙がっていた。２９日の試合を終えた時点で、打者としては今季１３０試合に出場し、打率２割８分３厘、３０本塁打、８０打点の成績を残している。

FAST

CAIRO: Egypt's Banque Misr said on Saturday (Aug 29) it was reviewing a US Treasury notice to cut off its UAE branches from dollar transactions over their dealings with Iran, while the UAE central bank said it had launched an urgent examination of the branches following the US action. The US imposition of Iran-related sanctions on the Egyptian bank comes as part of Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's campaign to increase economic pressure to try to break a stalemate six months into Washington's war with Iran. Banque Misr said its branch in the UAE continued to provide banking services to its customers in accordance with the applicable rules and procedures. The UAE central bank said later on Saturday it had decided to conduct a "special and urgent examination" of Banque Misr's branches in the country, including "a forensic/in-depth lookback covering the period referred to in the statement issued by the US authorities". "The Central Bank expects banks licensed in the UAE not to expose the UAE's financial system to reputational risks, to respect the laws and regulations of the countries whose financial institutions are used in conducting transactions, and not to misuse the advanced financial infrastructure of the UAE," it added in a statement.

FAST

Aug 29 : U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said disorderly moves in the yen could trigger "forced unwinds" of positions that risk destabilizing global markets and ultimately raising borrowing costs for U.S. households and businesses. Bessent made the comments in a letter dated August 27 and posted on his X account a day later in response to Democratic Senator Elizabeth Warren's demand for an explanation of Washington's joint currency intervention with Tokyo last month. The post came as the yen resumed weakening against the dollar despite expectations the Bank of Japan could raise interest rates in the near term. Japan and the United States carried out a rare joint yen-buying intervention on July 31, signaling their determination to prevent a selloff in the yen and Japanese government bonds from spilling over into global markets.

While the yen has recovered from a 40-year low near 164 per dollar hit last month, it has weakened back towards 160 after surging to 155.20 shortly after the intervention. The currency briefly slipped below the 160-per-dollar level on Friday, a threshold widely seen as increasing the likelihood of intervention, after comments from Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh revived expectations of a near-term U.S. rate hike. In the letter, Bessent said the Treasury conducted the intervention by exchanging foreign-currency assets held in its Exchange Stabilization Fund (ESF) for yen. "The same principle was at work in Argentina, where Treasury used the Exchange Stabilization Fund to stabilize Argentina in a moment of acute, short-term illiquidity and to prevent the problem from becoming a broader regional crisis," he said. "The best-managed crisis is the one that never happens," Bessent said, defending Washington's decision to join Tokyo's efforts to counter disorderly declines in the yen. The ESF is an emergency reserve managed by the U.S. Treasury to stabilize foreign-exchange and domestic financial markets. The Treasury used the ESF last year to help support Argentina's peso market and provide a $20 billion currency swap line aimed at stabilizing the currency.

Source: Reuters

Temasek backs SIA's Air India investment amid growing scrutiny

Air India's request for about US$1.5 billion in fresh equity from owners Tata Sons and SIA has drawn questions about the Singapore carrier's decision to invest in it.

Visitors gather near India's first Air India Airbus A350 during the 'Wings India 2024' at Begumpet Airport in Hyderabad, on Jan 18, 2024. (File photo: AFP/Noah Seelam)

FAST

NEW DELHI: Temasek, the majority shareholder of Singapore Airlines (SIA), on Saturday (Aug 29) backed the airline's investment in Air India, as scrutiny grows over its stake in the loss-making Indian carrier. Air India's request for about US$1.5 billion in fresh equity from owners Tata Sons and SIA was first reported by Reuters this week. SIA owns 25.1 per cent of India's second-largest airline, with the rest owned by Tata. News of the funding request prompted Mr Kenneth Tiong, a lawmaker from Singapore's opposition Workers' Party, to urge that Temasek's funds not be used to shore up the Indian carrier. Singapore's Business Times also ran a commentary arguing that SIA could not realistically exit its Air India stake, with Tata the only plausible buyer.

It questioned what its 25.1 per cent holding offered beyond a board seat and a share of the losses, while saying the strategic logic of the investment still held. In a letter to the newspaper responding to that commentary, Juliet Teo, joint head of portfolio development at Temasek Singapore, said Temasek viewed SIA's decision to invest in Air India from a long-term perspective and was supportive of it. The letter said the transformation of Air India involved complex, multi-year operational and integration challenges, with outcomes shaped by industry developments and external factors such as airspace disruptions, geopolitical developments and fuel price volatility. "Efforts of this scale take time and are not expected to be linear," it said. Temasek did not address whether it would support any capital contribution by SIA to Air India. Air India's multibillion-dollar revamp has been under way since Tata took control of the former state-owned carrier in 2022. Air India has been hit by Pakistan's airspace ban on Indian carriers, disruptions from the US-Israeli war with Iran and the fallout from a crash last year that killed 260 people. In the year to March, the airline and its budget unit Air India Express posted combined losses of US$2.33 billion, weighing on SIA's profits. SIA said on Thursday its board would carefully consider any requests for additional capital from Air India, taking into consideration the group's other capital requirements and Air India's business strategy.

A firefighter works at the site of a Russian drone attack, amid Russia's attack on Ukraine, in the Kyiv region, Ukraine, in this handout picture released on Aug 29, 2026. (Photo: State of Emergency Service of Ukraine in Kyiv region)

29 Aug 2026 09:33PM (Updated: 29 Aug 2026 10:15PM)

FAST

KYIV: At least 37 people were killed after a Russian drone strike on a Kyiv-area ammunition depot sparked a detonation, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Saturday (Aug 29), vowing to punish suspected negligence in the second such incident in two months. The deadliest Russian strike in the Kyiv area this year came as Moscow's air attacks on the Ukrainian capital and surrounding region dragged into a third straight day, killing residents, damaging homes and derailing daily life. Dozens were also injured and hundreds evacuated from the area of the strike in the village of Myla, Zelenskyy said, where nearby infrastructure including residential buildings and a facility for the elderly and people with disabilities suffered "significant damage". The attack sparked widespread fires, officials said. Among those killed was the head of a neighbouring village who rushed to help.

"A terrible situation and terrible negligence on the part of those who stored explosives right next to people," Zelenskyy said in a video address.

Related:

Ukraine backers gather as war escalates, air defence runs low

CIA director warned Russia not to attack NATO members: US media

SECOND STRIKE-RELATED DETONATION IN TWO MONTHS The site of Friday's blast was a military facility that held artillery shells, mines and drones, among other ammunition, said the Ukrainian president. It followed a similar incident in the Kyiv-area town of Vyshneve last month, when 10 people were killed and hundreds of houses damaged after a strike triggered secondary explosions. "Another such crime - after what happened in Vyshneve - is absolutely unacceptable," Zelenskyy said. "I expect the details to be presented to the public promptly." He added that criminal cases had already been opened on charges of official negligence. Ukrainian officials rarely disclose damage to military targets from Russian attacks. In a statement on Saturday, Ukraine's Defence Ministry said all those responsible for weapons storage should complete a full audit of their locations.

Also read:

Ukraine says Russia fired North Korean missiles in deadly attack

DRONE SWARMS AIMED AT KYIV Nine other regions had been targeted in overnight strikes by Russia, Zelenskyy added, saying Kyiv in particular was under "virtually non-stop attack" from high-speed drones. Russia has escalated its air war on Ukraine with increasing numbers of elusive ballistic missiles and new high-speed drones, which Kyiv lacks the air defences to shoot down. On Saturday, sirens blared throughout the morning for a third straight day as Ukraine's air force warned of new waves of drones approaching the capital. The sound of air defences could be heard booming across the sky. Kyiv region governor Tymur Tkachenko said a 14-year-old girl was killed in a morning drone strike on the Boryspil district. In Kyiv, a 2-year-old girl was killed by a downed drone, Mayor Vitali Klitschko said on Saturday. Strikes in and around Kyiv on Thursday and Friday had damaged warehouses and homes, part of what some Ukrainian officials said was a campaign aimed at "paralysing" the city of several million.

Source: Reuters/rl

item.title: ネパール・中国土石流、なお約3000人不明 死者600人超
item.description: [カトマンズ ２９日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[カトマンズ ２９日 ロイター] - ネパール当局は２９日、中国チベット自治区との国境地帯を襲った大規模土石流の捜索・救助活動を悪天候のために中断した。またワグル財務相は、政府による初期の試算で、復興に４０─５０億ドルが必要になるとロイターに語った。

当局によると、２６日に発生した土石流と洪水では、これまでにネパールで少なくとも６２６人、中国チベット自治区で７人が死亡した。行方不明者は約３０００人に上り、ネパールで約２４２６人、チベット自治区の吉隆県で少なくとも５５８人。うち外国人が約５４０人含まれ、その多くはインドからのヒンズー教巡礼者だという。

被害の大きいラスワ郡の高官は２９日、「雨が降り、霧がかかっているため、捜索・救助活動を一時的に停止した」と語った。前日も、災害原因とみられる氷河崩落で形成された湖が越水したことなどから、救助が一時中断した。

この湖は、ネパール当局が監視している洪水発生地点の上流にある２つの湖のうちの一つ。当局者は、両湖が完全に排水されるまで洪水リスクは続くと警告した。

中国国営の新華社通信は２８日、当局の分析によると、うち１つの湖は縮小しつつあると伝えた。ただ、中国政府の地質災害専門家はこの湖について、不安定な状態にある可能性を指摘。周辺に点在する１００以上の氷河湖も脅威となり得ると述べた。

ネパールのカナル外相は、捜索・救助活動そのものに支援は必要ないとしつつ、トンネルに閉じ込められた人々の救出、橋が破壊された地域での輸送・通信網の復旧、遺体の身元確認、ＤＮＡ鑑定、遺体の長期保管については技術的な支援が必要だと述べた。

ワグル財務相は２８日、ロイターの取材に、災害からの復興に必要な費用は初期試算で４０億─５０億ドルの規模になるとの見通しを示した。「あくまで試算に過ぎず、被害状況は現在評価中だ」と述べた。

約９０００人が死亡し、ネパール史上最悪の自然災害となった２０１５年の大地震では復興費が９０億ドルに上ったが、現時点でそれよりは少ない額になるだろうと述べた。

item.title: 中国メモリー大手ＣＸＭＴ、米国防総省を提訴 「軍事企業」指定巡り
item.description:
Che Pan Mrinmay Dey
[２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Che Pan　Mrinmay Dey

[２８日 ロイター] - 中国の最大手メモリー半導体メーカー、長鑫存儲技術（ＣＸＭＴ）は２８日、中国軍を支援する企業として米国防総省のリストに掲載されたことを不服として、同省を首都ワシントンの連邦地裁に提訴した。

同社は訴状で「中国軍と関係はなく、ＤＲＡＭチップは民生・商用向けに設計、製造、販売している」と主張。指定の取り消しと、政府調達の制限や評判悪化を招く同リストからの除外を求めている。

同社はバイデン前政権下で「中国軍事企業」に指定され、トランプ政権も６月の更新で指定を維持した。国防総省は「係争中の訴訟にはコメントしない」と述べた。

ＣＸＭＴは中国最大のＤＲＡＭメーカーで、２０２６年上半期の売上高は前年同期比８７４％急増。米国市場への参入も目指している。

同社は「２５年１月の指定以降、評判および商業上の損害を継続的に被ってきた」と説明。指定は「恣意的」で証拠を欠き、適正手続きの権利を侵害していると訴えた。

６月には中国のテクノロジー・電子商取引（ＥＣ）大手アリババもリスト掲載を巡り米政府を提訴している。

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝岡本が27号含む2安打3打点、鈴木も3安打 菅野8敗目
item.description: ［２８日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２８日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）は２８日、各地で試合を行い、ブルージェイズの岡本和真内野手はマリナーズ戦に「６番・三塁」で先発出場し、３打数２安打３打点の活躍を見せた。

岡本は一回に勝ち越しの犠飛を放つと、六回には７試合ぶりとなる２７号ソロ。七回にも適時内野安打を放った。ブルージェイズは８─１で快勝した。

カブスの鈴木誠也外野手はレッズ戦に「２番・右翼」で先発し、二塁打２本を含む５打数３安打２打点。カブスは８─１０で敗れ、３連敗となった。

ツインズ戦に「２番・一塁」で先発出場したホワイトソックスの村上宗隆内野手は、４打数２安打１四球、１得点だった。ホワイトソックスは７─４で勝利し、３連勝を飾った。

ドジャースの大谷翔平選手はタイガース戦に「１番・指名打者」で先発し、４打数無安打、１四球、２三振だった。ドジャースは２─１で逆転勝ちし、連敗を３で止めた。

ロッキーズの菅野智之投手はブレーブス戦に先発し、４回０／３を１０安打６失点、４奪三振、２四死球で８敗目（１２勝）を喫した。ロッキーズは４─６で敗れた。

メッツの千賀滉大投手はアストロズ戦の九回に５番手で登板し、１回を無安打無失点、２奪三振と３者凡退に抑えた。メッツは１─３で敗れ、３連敗となった。

FAST

Aug 28 : OpenAI said on Friday that it plans to stop providing AI models to Cursor, the coding-tool company now owned by Elon Musk's SpaceX, marking a further escalation in the bitter rivalry between OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Musk. Musk and Altman have been at odds for years, a feud that culminated earlier this year in a trial over Musk's $150 billion lawsuit against OpenAI. During the trial, Musk's lawyer said that Musk and other witnesses had testified that Altman was a liar, while OpenAI argued that Musk had sought control of the company. "We are making this choice because we cannot be confident that SpaceX will use our technology within our terms of service, based on our experience with Elon Musk's companies violating contracts," OpenAI said in a blog post. Musk responded early on Saturday in an X post, writing, "I couldn't care less."

He accused Altman and OpenAI President Greg Brockman of being "untrustworthy," while repeating his assertion that they "stole an open source nonprofit." Musk, the world's richest person, had sued OpenAI and Altman for "stealing a charity" by betraying the company's original nonprofit mission for their own enrichment. A federal jury ruled against Musk earlier this year, finding that he had filed the case too late. However, Michael Truell, a co-founder of Cursor and now an executive at SpaceX, said on X that the company was speaking with the OpenAI team to resolve this issue. Hours after OpenAI's announcement, Anthropic, which rivals both firms but has an ongoing partnership with SpaceX, said it planned to increase compute to support Claude models in Cursor, according to Tom Brown, one of the co-founders of the firm. In its blog post, OpenAI said that X, formerly known as Twitter and now part of SpaceX, had breached the terms of its contract with OpenAI after Musk acquired the platform. "To work with a large partner like SpaceX, we typically rely on custom contracts to ensure compliance with our terms of service and that the integration provides for safety at scale," the AI company added. The ChatGPT-maker said it proposed a shutoff date of November 12, 2026, adding that its agreement with Cursor gave it a limited time window to cancel the contract following "a change of control." SpaceX announced a deal to buy Anysphere, the startup behind Cursor, for $60 billion in an all-stock deal in June, and completed the acquisition earlier this month.

Source: Reuters

item.description: Washington entend intensifier davantage la pression économique sur l'Iran, dit Bessent
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Washington entend intensifier davantage la pression économique sur l'Iran, dit Bessent ASHEVILLE, Caroline du Nord, 31 août (Reuters) - Le département américain du Trésor va vraisemblablement dévoiler de manière hebdomadaire de nouvelles sanctions dites secondaires destinées à intensifier la pression économique sur l'Iran, avec le secteur bancaire comme priorité initiale, a déclaré dimanche à Reuters le secrétaire américain au Trésor, Scott Bessent. Les Etats-Unis frappent deux lanceurs iraniens sur l'île de Larak-Officiel US WASHINGTON, 30 août (Reuters) - L'armée américaine a frappé dimanche deux lanceurs iraniens sur l'île iranienne de Larak, a annoncé un responsable américain, première frappe américaine connue sur l'Iran depuis la fin juillet. Allemagne-Une victoire de l'AfD en Saxe-Anhalt refroidirait les investisseurs étrangers Le chancelier allemand Friedrich Merz a déclaré dimanche qu'une victoire du parti d'extrême-droite AfD aux élections régionales de Saxe-Anhalt la semaine prochaine nuirait à ce Land de l'Est du pays et dissuaderait les entreprises étrangères d'y investir. Avant la catastrophe, le Népal avait demandé à la Chine un système d'alarme précoce KATMANDOU, 30 août (Reuters) - Trois mois avant qu'un énorme torrent d'eau, de boue et de roches tue plusieurs centaines de personnes dans une vallée de l'Himalaya à la frontière du Népal et de la Chine, des experts et des officiels des deux pays s'étaient réunis à Katmandou pour discuter des risques entourant de tels phénomènes. Inondations-La Chine a identifié les pays d'origine de 261 étrangers portés disparus PÉKIN/TRISHULI, 30 août (Reuters) - La Chine a annoncé dimanche que 261 ressortissants étrangers originaires de 23 pays étaient portés disparus du côté tibétain de la frontière avec le Népal à la suite de la coulée de boue dévastatrice qui a fait des centaines de morts et ravagé la région cette semaine. L'Islande dit "non" à une reprise des négociations d'adhésion à l'UE REYKJAVIK, 30 août (Reuters) - Les Islandais ont rejeté dimanche la proposition d'une reprise des négociations d'adhésion à l'Union européenne (UE) à l'issue du référendum organisé samedi, infligeant un camouflet au gouvernement et se rangeant du côté de ceux qui y voyaient un risque quant à la souveraineté des eaux de pêche du pays. Le bilan de l'attaque russe dans la région de Kyiv s'alourdit à 38 morts - Zelensky Kyiv, 30 août (Reuters) - Le bilan de la frappe russe sur un dépôt de munitions dans la région de Kyiv, en Ukraine, s'élève désormais à 38 morts, tandis que les recherches se poursuivent pour retrouver quatre personnes toujours portées disparues, a déclaré dimanche le président Volodimir Zelensky. Le Népal commence les enterrements de masse de victimes impossibles à identifier CHITWAN, Népal, 30 août (Reuters) - La région de Chitwan au Népal, réputée pour ses forêts et ses rivières, est devenue le théâtre d'enterrements de masse pour des centaines de victimes des crues meurtrières qui ont frappé l'Himalaya cette semaine, et dont les corps, impossibles à identifier, ont été emportés par une coulée de roches, de glace et de boue dévastatrice. Suisse-Un mort et cinq blessés lors d'une fusillade dans une rave party AARAU, Suisse, 30 août (Reuters) - Une femme de 22 ans a été tuée et cinq personnes blessées, dont certaines grièvement, au cours d'une fusillade survenue lors d'une rave party dans la ville suisse d'Aarau, dans le nord du pays, a indiqué dimanche la police locale. Un bateau transportant 267 personnes chavire au large de Chypre, 7 morts NICOSIE, 30 août (Reuters) - Au moins sept personnes ont trouvé la mort et 23 sont portées disparues après qu'un bateau transportant environ 270 personnes a chaviré dimanche au large des côtes de la partie nord de Chypre, ont annoncé les autorités.

item.title: OFRTP Summary
item.description: France-Olivier Faure annonce sa candidature à la présidentielle
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: France-Olivier Faure annonce sa candidature à la présidentielle Olivier Faure, Premier secrétaire du Parti socialiste, a annoncé dimanche sa candidature à l'élection présidentielle du printemps 2027 et sa participation dans ce sens à la primaire "de la gauche socialiste et démocratique" qui aura lieu en deux tours les 9-10 et 16-17 octobre prochains. Le RN cherche toujours un prêt pour financer sa campagne-Bardella Le Rassemblement national (RN) est toujours à la recherche d'un prêt bancaire pour financer sa campagne pour l'élection présidentielle du printemps 2027, a dit samedi sur BFMTV le président du RN Jordan Bardella. Près de 1.500 disparus au Népal et en Chine après les crues soudaines Près de 1.500 personnes, dont plus de 700 ressortissants étrangers, sont portées disparues après qu'un glissement de terre composé de boue et de roches s'est déversé mercredi dans une rivière de l'Himalaya, provoquant des crues soudaines à la frontière entre le Népal et le Tibet chinois. L'artiste japonaise Yayoi Kusama est morte à 97 ans L'artiste japonaise Yayoi Kusama, qui a su s'inspirer des hallucinations dont elle souffrait pour créer des oeuvres d'art, est morte à l'âge de 97 ans. Ukraine: Zelensky nomme deux commandants pour renforcer la défense de Donetsk Le président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky a annoncé mercredi la nomination de deux officiers chevronnés à la tête de deux nouvelles unités sur le front de Donetsk afin de renforcer la défense de cette région de l'est de l'Ukraine, constamment sous la menace des assauts des forces russes. Une courte majorité d'Islandais favorable aux discussions d'adhésion à l'UE, selon un sondage Une faible majorité d'Islandais soutient la reprise de négociations d'adhésion à l'Union européenne lors du référendum national prévu ce samedi, selon un nouveau sondage d'opinion, qui montre un resserrement de l'écart. Tereos voit la production UE du sucre tomber à un plus bas de 38 ans Le premier producteur français de sucre Tereos a dit mercredi que la production européenne de sucre devrait tomber en 2026-2027 à son niveau le plus bas depuis 38 ans en raison de l'impact de la sécheresse et des canicules à répétition qui ont caractérisé cet été. France-Vingt personnes hospitalisées après la tornade dans l'Aude La tornade qui a frappé lundi la commune de Pomas (Aude), qui compte un peu plus de 1.000 habitants, a entraîné l'hospitalisation de vingt personnes et détruit ou endommagé 300 habitations, a déclaré mardi le préfet du département. La France et l'Arabie saoudite vont construire un parc "Dragon Ball Z" près de Paris La France et l'Arabie saoudite vont construire un parc d'attractions sur le thème de la franchise japonaise de mangas Dragon Ball Z près de Paris, un projet d'un montant de six milliards d'euros, a annoncé lundi l'Élysée à l'occasion d'une visite en France du prince héritier saoudien Mohammed ben Salmane. Attaques de drones ukrainiens en Russie, cinq morts selon les autorités russes Trois adolescents ont été tués et huit autres personnes, dont sept enfants, ont été blessées lors d'une attaque de drones ukrainiens dans la nuit de dimanche à lundi dans la région russe de Krasnodar, dans le sud de la Russie, ont indiqué les autorités russes.
